title: The multiple merger assembly of a hyperluminous obscured quasar at redshift 4.6
question: Is the hyper-luminous obscured quasar W2246−0526 (z=4.6) undergoing a multiple merger, with dusty bridges and tidal tails connecting it to companion galaxies?

data.sensitivity: ~125 µJy/beam/channel in 48 km/s channels; 11.5 µJy/beam in moment-0 map

what.value: Earlier ALMA [C II] data: redshift, companions, 7.4 mJy flux density at 158 µm, line luminosities

evidence.quote: ALMA observations showed that the dust continuum flux density at rest-frame ~ 158 µm is 7.4 mJy

what.value: Photometry for SED: Spitzer, WISE, Herschel SPIRE, Ks

evidence.quote: Herschel at 250, 350 and 500 µm with the Spectral and Photometric Imaging Receiver (SPIRE)

external_data.citation: Tsai et al. 2015; Griffith et al. 2012; Wright et al. 2010; Assef et al. 2015

recipe.method: Concatenate EBs and clean with tclean, collapse four SPWs to moment-0 map
key_parameters: briggs robust=2, hogbom, 1″ mask, 2σ clean depth

recipe.method: AIPS/CASA calibration, tclean with briggs robust=2, hogbom, primary beam corrected
Optically thin modified blackbody scaled to continuum flux; gas = 100 × dust; CO-based gas with alpha_CO
key_parameters: Tdust 50–100 K for W2246, 25–50 K for companions/extended
assumptions: beta=1.8, kappa(850µm)=0.0484 m2/kg, gas-to-dust 100, alpha_CO,MW=4.6 and ULIRG=0.8

recipe.goal: Stellar mass and SFR via SED fitting
recipe.method: Empirical AGN + galaxy templates (Assef 2010), mass-to-light via ezgal/Galaxev
assumptions: Z=0.008, Chabrier IMF, exponentially declining SFHs

recipe.goal: Dynamical mass, free-fall time and accretion rate
recipe.method: Dispersion-supported Mdyn from [C II] FWHM and size; tff at C3 distance; dMgas/dt = gas mass / tff

evidence.loc: Calculation of Dust and Gas Masses
evidence.quote: This corresponds to a dust mass in the range M dust ~ 5.6–17 × 10 [8 ] M ¤ ( T dust = 100–50 K, respectively).
